name: Yantai Shuangta Food Co., Ltd.
summary: Yantai Shuangta Food Co., Ltd. primarily produces and sells vermicelli under the Longkou brand name in China. It also provides pea protein, starch, and fiber products; vermicelli products; pure soybeans and mixed grains; sweet potato vermicelli under the Shuangta, Longtou, Luyu, Qingta, and Deshengta brands; and pea protein powder. The company was formerly known as Yantai Jinhua Cellophane Noodles Co., Ltd and changed its name to Yantai Shuangta Food Co., Ltd. in April 2008. Yantai Shuangta Food Co., Ltd. was founded in 1992 and is based in Zhaoyuan, the People's Republic of China.
